say:1:1223106001:0.text: What an unlucky day! I shouldn't have let those scoundrels touch my goods!
say:1:1223106001:0.source_cn: 流年不利，我就不该给这些混蛋机会运货！
say:1:1223106001:0.male: What an unlucky day! I shouldn't have let those scoundrels touch my goods!
say:1:1223106001:0.female: What an unlucky day! I shouldn't have let those scoundrels touch my goods!

say:2:1223106002:0.text: Good thing you guys are here, or I'd be in big trouble today.
say:2:1223106002:0.source_cn: 还好有你们在，不然今天我就倒霉透了。
say:2:1223106002:0.male: Good thing you guys are here, or I'd be in big trouble today.
say:2:1223106002:0.female: Good thing you guys are here, or I'd be in big trouble today.
